title: piRNA Discovery Pipeline Parameters
description: Validation schema for the piRNA Discovery Pipeline

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

reads.description: Path to input data (must be surrounded with quotes)

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Options for reference genomes and databases.

rfam_mirbase_prefix.description: Prefix for the Rfam/miRBase bowtie index

genome_prefix.description: Prefix for the target genome bowtie index

pirbase.description: Path to the piRBase FASTA file

execution_options.title: Execution options
execution_options.description: Options for how the pipeline should be executed.

threads.description: Number of threads to use per process
